title: Work instruction adaptation studio

stages.name: recoverProcedure
stages.algorithm: Parse the master instruction into actions, guards, prerequisites, and verification obligations. Distinguish explanatory advice from mandatory controls, preserve warnings in their operative context, and identify cross-references needed to execute the procedure correctly.
stages.gate: Every mandatory control has a traceable source and cannot disappear during simplification.

stages.name: mapLocalContext
stages.algorithm: Compare local equipment, materials, staffing, and terminology with the master procedure. Separate harmless naming differences from capability changes and identify where local conditions make a step impossible or require engineering review.
stages.gate: Local compatibility is verified; unknown critical differences block adaptation.

stages.name: constructVariant
stages.algorithm: Rewrite steps for the local context using approved terminology and resources. Preserve sequence, guards, stop conditions, and verification; represent genuine deviations explicitly rather than hiding them in friendlier wording or inferred substitutions.
stages.gate: All master safety and prerequisite obligations survive unless explicitly superseded by authorized engineering change.

stages.name: replayProcedure
stages.algorithm: Generate ordinary and adverse scenarios involving local exceptions, missing resources, and interrupted work. Replay the adapted procedure to detect ambiguous instructions, skipped prerequisites, or branches that cannot reach a safe terminal state.
stages.gate: No scenario bypasses a retained safeguard or requires an unavailable capability.

stages.name: releaseInstruction
stages.algorithm: Obtain qualified review of the exact variant, publish controlled copies, and coordinate acknowledgment or training. Retire outdated copies without erasing historical execution records and re-evaluate affected instructions when equipment or master procedures change.
stages.gate: Approved version and site applicability are visible at every point of use.

operational_details: A printed instruction remains on the floor: include version identifiers and a withdrawal task.
A local term names two controls: require unambiguous equipment references.
A translation shortens a warning: verify semantic preservation before release.
A procedure is interrupted mid-step: specify restart and re-verification conditions.
A local exception waives a queue but not an inspection: preserve the inspection guard explicitly.
